instagram.caption:
The fourth coat.
The Family Hook Zone in the Mudroom. Holds the coats and bags that leave in the morning and come back the same evening.

What done looks like:
1. One bag per person
2. Each on their own named column
3. The lowest hooks set at the height of the shortest person in the house
4. Bare floor along the whole run of wall beneath them

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success family hook zone.
